benchmark: candidates-2026-11-22 (frozen, 50 upstream LLMs: 25 latest + 25 popular; rules and sources inside the file)
harness: ~/.claude/agents/catalog-maintainer.md (role: measurement method, retirement and Pareto rules)
kpi: C = covered/candidates over the frozen candidates file
promotion: target final held-out minus target STARTING held-out > 0 with the memory present, and the four conditions run matched on target policy, tasks, rounds and candidate budget. The STARTING held-out is measured at the start of the target session, not taken from the source ledger: the KPI is the engine, the machine drifts 10-20% between half-hours, and a number carried across a session is not a baseline. A target that scores below its own starting held-out is negative transfer and is reported as such, not credited.
stop: the KPI reaches its target, or the budget is spent, or two consecutive rounds record no realised prediction.
